Name: Living Seasonal Crops
Author: AlexisBloodwood
Description: Have you ever planted seasonal seeds and then whacked the ones you thought were dead only to find out they were thriving from a friend? Well never fear my fellow farmer for I have the CP download for you! With one simple file your fears of mistaking a living crop for a brown dead one have joined Joja (and Morris) back in the city!

Downloads.Description: Recolors the brown crop to green.
